name: 0000-MAIN
description: The paragraph initializes key operations, displays a message for logging or diagnostic purposes, and transfers control to a fetch loop for further processing.

algorithm.details: Sets up initial values needed for processing.
Begins iterating through a fetch loop (1000-FETCH-LOOP).
Outputs information for logging or diagnostics.
Indicates the end of the program execution for the current call.

sideEffects.description: A message is displayed to the runtime environment.
